ov: الإرهابي هو فلم مصري أُنتِج عام 1994، من بطولة عادل إمام، وشيرين، وصلاح ذو الفقار، ومديحة يسري. ويُعد من الأفلام السياسية، كتبه لينين الرملي، وأخرجه نادر جلال، وأُنتج تحت حراسة مشدَّدة من الشرطة. وهو الفلم الأخير للفنان صلاح ذو الفقار.
plotEn: Brother Ali is an Islamic radical scheming against the government and Egyptian society. Hurt after escaping the scene of an assassination, he is taken by the girl who hit him to her father's house. Her father is Dr. Abdel Moneim, a famous doctor living with his family. They are a local modern Muslim family, unaware of his radical ties. After living with the family and learning about tolerance and love, he has doubts about his views. He is killed by his former comrades after challenging their leader.
